summary: Test only: the fractal-test-test fixture for build-slot waits no longer depends on how fast a loaded host starts its commands. It writes its queue-log wait rounded outward, from before the check starts until a second after the sleep, so only the command's exit after the slot line counts against the 2 s limit (#4879).

replay.detail: No stored data is read or written differently.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: A test fixture only; st-test and ci-local are unchanged.
